notes: Public CLOB order-book REST reads (GET /book, POST /books), reconstructed from the API-tab examples published on the source page and retrieved read-only and unauthenticated on 2026-08-27. Owned by WP-070, NOT part of the frozen WP-000 catalogue under test/fixtures/venue/. The page states verbatim: 'Bids are ordered by ascending price and asks by descending price, so the best bid and ask are the last entries in their respective arrays. Each response also includes a hash for the order-book state.' The identifiers are the documentation's own published examples; elided values such as '...' are replaced with full-length synthetic ones. Two hash forms are frozen because the page publishes both: its TypeScript tab prints a 40-character digest and its API tab a 64-character one for the same field, so a parser may pin neither. last_trade_price is frozen at the page's own non-canonical '0.090' spelling, which is evidence that the wire is not canonical. Round-1 review correction (M1, 2026-08-27): every example now carries market, asset_id, bids, asks, hash, min_order_size, tick_size and neg_risk, because the official OpenAPI for GET /book (https://docs.polymarket.com/api-reference/market-data/get-order-book.md, /api-spec/clob-openapi.yaml, OrderBookSummary) lists all ten properties under `required` and the SDK's OrderBookSchema requires those eight. The former 'single-book-empty-optionals' example asserted a response shape neither source publishes and is replaced by 'single-book-absent-optionals', which exercises only the two fields the SDK declares nullish.
